content.heading: Payroll that keeps your team and HMRC happy
content.content:
As soon as you pay an employee, or yourself as a company director, through PAYE, you take on monthly payroll duties: calculating pay correctly, reporting it to HMRC in real time and paying over tax and National Insurance on time. Mistakes affect your people directly, so getting it right every month matters.

We run payroll for:
- Limited companies paying a salary to their directors
- Small businesses with a handful of employees
- Growing teams that have outgrown spreadsheets
- Employers who want to hand payroll over to a specialist

Everything happens online. You tell us about hours, changes, starters and leavers before each pay run, we process it, and you approve it before anyone is paid.

content.heading: Payroll deadlines and what we need from you
content.content:
Under Real Time Information, employers must report pay to HMRC on or before each payday through a Full Payment Submission. The PAYE and National Insurance you owe is usually due by the 22nd of the following month when paid electronically.

At the end of each tax year, employees must receive a P60 by 31 May. Employers also have ongoing workplace pension duties under auto-enrolment, including enrolling eligible staff and paying contributions on time.

Before each monthly pay run we will usually need:
- Hours worked, overtime, bonuses or commission
- Details of new starters, including their starter checklist
- Leaving dates for anyone who has left
- Any sickness, maternity, paternity or other statutory pay

items.question: Can you run payroll for just me as a director?
items.answer: Yes. Many limited company directors pay themselves a salary through PAYE. We run it monthly, file RTI and keep it in line with your wider tax planning.

items.question: Can you take over from my current payroll provider?
items.answer: Yes. We collect your year-to-date figures and employee details so the switch happens without any break in pay or reporting.

items.question: Do you handle workplace pensions?
items.answer: Yes. We assess your staff for auto-enrolment, calculate contributions each pay run and give you the information your pension provider needs.

items.question: What is RTI?
items.answer: Real Time Information is how employers report pay to HMRC. A Full Payment Submission is sent on or before each payday, showing what each employee was paid and what was deducted.

items.question: Can you pay weekly instead of monthly?
items.answer: Our standard service is monthly payroll. If you need a different pay frequency, mention it when you book and we will discuss what we can offer.

items.question: How much does payroll cost?
items.answer: We quote after a free consultation. The price depends mainly on how many people you pay and how much changes from month to month.

items.question: Do I need to meet you in person?
items.answer: No. Everything is handled online: consultations by video call, changes shared digitally and payslips delivered electronically.
